evidence.estrutura: Jahangir worked through courts, civil society and international institutions to constrain abusive government rather than advancing a distinctive federal-versus-centralized territorial model. Keep structure moderate.
evidence.representacao: She challenged military dictatorship, founded human-rights institutions, led the Supreme Court Bar Association and defended democratic civil society. This strongly supports representative democracy and accountable institutions.
evidence.poder: Her career centered resistance to arbitrary detention, extrajudicial killing, enforced disappearances, censorship and emergency rule. This strongly supports civil liberties and strict constraints on coercive state power.
evidence.imigracao: Her rights work defended minorities and displaced or vulnerable people, but the reviewed sources do not establish a detailed immigration/border program. Use inclusive universalism with caution.
evidence.diplomacia: As a UN Special Rapporteur and South Asian peacebuilding participant, Jahangir worked through international law, monitoring and dialogue. This strongly supports multilateral diplomacy.
evidence.intervencao: Her human-rights framework favored international accountability but not military adventurism. This supports non-military international engagement and relative restraint toward armed intervention.
evidence.economia: Her legal-aid work included bonded laborers and marginalized communities, supporting labor rights and social protections, but she did not advocate a complete socialist ownership model.
evidence.controle: She supported legal regulation to protect workers and vulnerable groups, but no evidence supports centralized economic planning. Use moderate regulation.
evidence.comercio: No reliable trade-policy doctrine is established.
evidence.religiao: As UN Special Rapporteur on freedom of religion or belief and opponent of discriminatory religious laws, she defended freedom of conscience and minority rights rather than clerical state control. This supports secular/plural constitutional institutions.
evidence.moral: Her defense of women, children, religious minorities, journalists and other marginalized groups strongly supports progressive equality and human-rights norms.
evidence.tecnologia: Her work focused on law and human rights rather than technological policy. No distinctive technology ideology is established.
